key.name: tiles
key.description: List of {id, title, icon, primary, sections, wide, indicator}. icon is "auto" or "mdi:name"; sections are "area:ID", "group:ID", or "unassigned".

key.name: groups
key.description: List of {id, name, icon, devices, entities}. Members of a custom group are not shown in their Home Assistant area.

key.name: domains
key.summary: Entity types shown in area sections
key.description: Custom groups show every entity type of their members.

key.name: show-ha-hidden
key.summary: Show entities that are hidden in Home Assistant

key.name: group-controls
key.summary: Show combined controls on section headers
key.description: A section gets a combined switch when it has toggleable members, and a combined brightness slider or color picker only when at least two members support it.
